claims.head: There’s no curse: Woll vs. The Senators
claims.body: Woll has been shaky against the Senators since 2023-24, well below his usual. But three seasons of data say a goalie’s record against one team tells us nothing about the next meeting, so don’t be surprised if he looks like himself tonight.
claims.nums: 6 starts against Ottawa: .867 save percentage · .906 against everyone else
claims.gist: Don’t read much into Woll’s record against the Senators.
claims.call: If Woll starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .906 than to his .867 against the Senators.
claims.cite: Goalie starts since 2023-24 · 6 against Ottawa, 3,022 shots against everyone else

chips.tip: Woll: .867 save percentage in 6 starts against Ottawa since 2023-24.
Woll: .906 save percentage against everyone else since 2023-24, on 3,022 shots.

check.rule: held if he starts and his save percentage is closer to his usual than to his record against this team; can't judge if he doesn't start

claims.head: A brick wall vs. A revolving door
claims.body: The Senators keep shots away, but the Flyers give up plenty. Ottawa is near the top of the league for shot suppression, and Philadelphia is one of the worst. Expect the Flyers to give up the bigger pile of shots.

notes.text: The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 4 games cover only 30% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the lowest share in the league (a typical team: 57%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Jordan Spence has started killing penalties: on the ice for 46% of the team’s shorthanded time in 3 games, up from 4% last season.

OTT.head: The matchup suits the Senators
OTT.body: Ottawa has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. The Flyers’ way back in is getting good looks.

PHI.head: The Flyers face a real test
PHI.body: Ottawa has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. The Flyers’ best way through is getting good looks.

story.head: The Flyers are still looking for their first win
paras: The Flyers are still looking for their first win of the season, 0-2-2 through four games. The Senators are 2-1-0.
Don’t read much into Woll’s record against the Senators. Expect plenty of hitting.
